thread:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-inference-gateway 5xx spike detected across eu-west-1 regions. p50 p95 increased, 502/504s from proxy -> runtime. See alerts/8142718281
monitoring-bot: samples: \n```
proxy: upstream returned 502 (conn-reset)\ngateway: request timeout after 15s\nkv-cache: miss rate jumped 18%\n```
maya: seeing customer reports of streaming timeouts + token truncation; support ticket #5721 flagged. Any recent deploys? :thinking_face:
support-sam: customer-impact: several mid-market tenants experienced 30-60s streaming stalls, some 5xx. We opened emergency support thread with affected customers. shared logs attached.
eli: rolling correlation: router config v2 pushed ~8142717000 -> saw spike ~30m later. auth-proxy 504s also increased concurrently. suspect routing change + keepalive behavior.
sanjay: can we quickly roll the router config back? `kubectl rollout undo deployment/gateway-router -n hosted` — doing a canary now.
alex: rolled back router to v1 at 8142719000. error rate dropped ~65% within 4m. p95 latency back down but still noisy. added temporary higher concurrency for dedicated pools.
maya: good rollback. ops-lead can you open a warroom? assign oncall and infra.
ops-lead: opened #warroom-8142718281, invited: @maya @eli @sanjay @alex @support-sam. link: https://redwood/warroom/8142718281 :clipboard:
eli: repro notes: can reproduce locally by sending streaming requests with long keepalive + small batches; gateway holds connections then backend returns 502 on cold kv-cache miss. suspect prefix caching regression in router change.
support-sam: tickets updated. customers notified of mitigation and rollback. keeping them informed. :thumbsup:
sanjay: temporary mitigations applied: increased gateway keepalive to 45s, bumped autoscaler min replicas + disabled aggressive batching heuristic. monitoring alerts throttled while we observe.
maya: capture next steps for postmortem and assign owners here.
ops-lead: POSTMORTEM ACTIONS (initial):\n- root-cause analysis: validate router change interaction with KV cache (eli) - due 8142760000\n- add canary gate for router config pushes (sanjay) - due 8142790000\n- instrument per-route timeout/queue metrics in the console (alex) - due 8142850000\n- improve staging preflight for streaming scenarios (maya) - due 8142800000\n- customer follow-up and apology notes + credits (support-sam) - due 8142750000
eli: early finding: config toggled `stream_prefetch` default -> true, increased prefix loads and caused more cold KV lookups under certain seq-lens. reproducer script attached: `scripts/repro_stream_kv.sh`.
ops-lead: assign owners updated in our task tracker. will run RCA next 48h and draft postmortem. please add any missing items.
alex: quick patch idea: make `stream_prefetch` opt-in for canaries, and add rate-limit on prefix loads. I'll open PR and request urgent review.
maya: thanks everyone. current status: rollback in prod, customer notifications in-flight, warroom ongoing but de-escalating. keep this thread for postmortem notes.

--- (follow-up 12h later) ---
ops-lead: Warroom summary posted. Error rates returned to baseline after rollback and keepalive tweak. No data loss. customers notified. moving to postmortem phase.
eli: RCA update: proven interaction between router prefetch + KV cache eviction policy causing head-of-line issues during high concurrency. More details in doc: https://redwood/ops/rca/8142718281
sanjay: infra task: implement canary gating and add a staged rollout for router flags. tracking task: INFRA-987. ETA 2 weeks.
alex: PR opened for opt-in prefetch + defensive rate-limit: PR#4821. hoping for fast-track review.
support-sam: customer comms drafted; credits approved for impacted tenants. will close support tickets after confirmation tomorrow.
maya: final ask: add automated test that simulates long streaming sessions + cold kv-cache for every release. assign to devex and eng-runtime. marking action-items in tracker.
ops-lead: closing warroom channel in 24h. postmortem doc will be published to /postmortems/8142718281 and linked in the final incident report. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
